motion_snippet.GSAP Snippet: const state = Flip.getState('.hero-image'); navigate(); Flip.from(state, { duration: 0.6, ease: 'expo.inOut', absolute: true, zIndex: 100 });
motion_snippet.Framework Notes: Requires the GSAP Flip plugin; the 'from' and 'to' route must render the same element with a shared data-flip-id; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
motion_snippet.Do: Verify the shared element exists in both DOM states before calling Flip.from to avoid a silent no-op
motion_snippet.Don't: Don't use shared-element transitions across more than one element pair per navigation; compounding Flips are hard to time correctly
motion_snippet.Performance Notes: Flip recalculates layout (FLIP technique) so test on low-end devices for jank
